conditions.L: Identical fixed statement and P65 shared files plus frozen NumStability library.
conditions.N: Identical fixed statement and P65 shared files; no NumStability artifact.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p65_t2_fabsum_backward_error (fp : P65FPModel) (b r : ℕ) ... : ∃ μ, componentwise gamma product bound and exact perturbed-input sum
formal_statement.plain_language: The computed FABsum is a perturbed-input sum with the exact composition of recursive and pairwise gamma bounds.

informal_proof: Apply the recursive backward-error representation to every block, apply the pairwise backward-error representation to the block sums, then multiply the two per-input factors as in Theorem 3.1.
informal_statement: For recursive summation within each block and pairwise summation of the block sums, FABsum is the exact sum of componentwise perturbed inputs with the product-composed gamma bound.

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: Both exact private proofs compile without sorry/admit; N imports no NumStability.

tier_rationale: The L proof calls two distinct substantial frozen results, recursiveSum_backward_error and pairwiseSum_backward_error, while N independently proves both by induction from the floating-point addition model. The 2020 paper explicitly combines these two algorithms in Theorem 3.1 and equation (3.7). N is over 380 lines; L is about 130 lines. Mathlib has no ready numerical summation backward-error theorems.
